BL-1546 — The land step excludes a path whose only owner is a ticket CLOSED on origin/main (the documenter's 'docs: BL-1518 guard how-to and feature narrative ...', 5dbd34f27f, inside BL-1537's own parcel): a closed ticket can never land again, so the content is orphaned and one EXCLUDED_SIBLING_PATH line is all that reports it; a closed-owner path is kept when the landing ticket touches it itself and otherwise refuses by name, never a silent exclusion
What it solves: ## What is wrong
Approval context: A new feature file is authored here, so it needs a tap. No choice is posed and there are no ruling_options. What is FIRM: the shape mirrors BL-1544 exactly - a path whose every owner is a ticket filed under backlog/done/ on origin/main (a positive read, never inferred from an unreadable folder) and…
